description: Eligible issuer/taxonomy/tag/unit/start/end groups with a valid latest filed date.
recommended_handling: Audit denominator only; do not select a value from it.

description: Same taxonomy/tag/unit/start/end group whose maximum filed date contains multiple values.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Non-exclusive source attribute: conflicting latest records have more than one accession.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Non-exclusive source attribute: conflicting latest records have one accession.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Non-exclusive source attribute: at least one conflicting latest record is an amended form.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Non-exclusive surrogate: FY/FP or frame differs. Company Facts supplies no context identifier, and start/end are already fixed by the group.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Same-accession conflict without amendment or available context surrogate difference; unresolved from Company Facts fields.
recommended_handling: Mark ambiguous/missing in a future canonical selector; no value/order/size tie-break is supported.

description: Different tags/taxonomies for the same audited economic concept, period, and latest filing date with differing values. This is semantic competition, not a same-tag tie and must not be auto-merged.
recommended_handling: Do not merge tags. Require an approved semantic priority before any construction.
